# Security reports for the multi-database fork

Report vulnerabilities in this fork privately through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/shea786/jellyfin/security/advisories/new).
Include the fork release or commit, database provider/version, reproduction steps and impact.
Do not include real passwords or access tokens in a public issue.

The current maintenance target is the latest published fork preview based on the latest stable upstream Jellyfin
release. SQLite and PostgreSQL are supported targets; MySQL/MariaDB and SQL Server remain experimental.
Preview builds have limited qualification and are intended for testing with recoverable data.

The fork maintainer reviews upstream security fixes and tests stable-baseline updates before publishing them.
This independent fork does not imply security review or support by the Jellyfin team.
